title: Resonance
oneliner: A fast twin-stick action game. Use your telekinetic voice to lift and control objects and enemies, allowing you to shield yourself and fight! Escape the facility trying to keep you under its control.
responsibilities: Developed a complete and polished level for a top-doihlwn twin-stick action game.
Iterated on the level design to improve gameplay flow and encourage emergent behaviours.
Scripted various level ingredients in Blueprints to create ameplay situations that interact with telekinetic abilities.
Rapidly developed several prototypes to search for gameplay beats fitting the player experience.

title: It's Not You It's Us
oneliner: A 3D point-and-click adventure about animal characters coming together to make their town a better place. Explore a cozy town as you meet the Urbanimals, and discover that taking care of the environment is something nobody can do on their own.
responsibilities: Developed 80% of a complete and polished level featuring multiple playable characters.
Iterated on the level design based on playtests to improve puzzles' flow and clarity.
Integrated a quest system and quest characters into the level to create a progression within the level using Unreal Engine 5.
Designed non-linear progression to encourage exploration of the space and focus on player agenda.

title: Base To Hell
oneliner: Action level for Quake. Infiltrate the military base and defeat the soldiers in your way to discover the secrets hidden away in the basement. Fight through numerous enemies, explore new areas, and unlock a gate to a hellish dimension.
responsibilities: Fully developed a complete and polished level for an existing first-person shooter game, using dedicated modding tool Trenchbroom.
Iterated on the level design based on playtests to improve the encounter design, pathfinding, and balancing of the gameplay.
Implemented scripted sequences to trigger combat encounters in previously-visited areas.
Set-dressed and textured the level to create two distinct areas within the same location.

title: Elysian
oneliner: Short dystopian psychological thriller about addiction and escapism. Two friends clash when their views on the euphoric drug create a rift between themselves.
responsibilities: Created a dystopian environment out of modular assets to display at LED Volume.
Integrated the virtual environment with the features of the physical set
Lit the environment in Unreal Engine 5 to realise the intended atmosphere on set.
Animated the 3D assets to create scripted transitions between different realities in sync with changes on physical set.

title: Prohibition Time
oneliner: An online multiplayer game. The game combines elements of the social deduction game “Mafia” (also known as “Werewolf”) extended by our team with cards and special actions.
responsibilities: Translated the tabletop game rules into a video game format with redesign to fit the restrictions of a web browser game.
Designed backend architecture to handle multiple game states, player actions, and multiplayer communication over live connection.
Created a state machine responsible for handling transisitions in the gameplay changing the available player actions each time and executing scripted events.

title: Moonsoup
oneliner: A 2D simulator game about running a potion shop set in a medieval fantasy setting. The game combines logical puzzles and mini-games in a design that focuses on creating a casual and relaxing gameplay.
responsibilities: Designed and implemented gardening system integrated with the day-night cycle.
Created a dialogue and quest system that contributed goals and rewards to the gameplay.
Designed and implemented various minigames based on player dexterity that allowed to expand the possibilities of potionmaking.
Collaborated with another developer on creating the potionmaking system.

title: Keep Talking and Nobody Gets Murdered
oneliner: A 2-player asymetrical coop game where one players is banquet infiltrator in VR, while the other looks from above and provides information and clues. Both players collaborate to unmask a hidden villain among the guests.
responsibilities: Designed an asymetrical gameplay experience for two player sharing identical goals, but have access to limited sets information each.
Created a level designed to house a large amount of roaming NPCs.
Collaborated on the puzzle design based on the information held by one of the players.
Designed for a VR experience, creating gameplay elements that lend into tactility, exploration and communication between the players.
Developed a full experience under 48 hour limit.

title: When the Dusk Comes
oneliner: A 2D clicker game where the player tries to shelter people before the apocalypse. The game combines button clicking with systems for saving humanity, heritage, and technology trees. By finding a balance and optimal strategies, players compete for the high score.
responsibilities: Designed upgrade and automation systems around a singular core mechanic of button clicking.
Implemented a scoring system based on various progressions available to the player.
Created a UI design for the clicker game genre expanded by numerous systems.
Iterated on the gameplay experience, UI/UX, and balance based on the playtests.
Developed a full experience under 24 hour limit.

title: Coal in my Heart
oneliner: A 2D side-scrolling platformer game that mixes a fighting system with survival mechanics. The player has to fight swarms of living icicles and snowflakes to reach the heating system, guarded by a boss who must be defeated to fix it.
responsibilities: Designed and implemented two types of enemies, each with a unique behavior that encourages different playstyles.
Created a boss fight consisting of three phases, each with a variety of telegraphed attacks.
Designed and implemented a platforming traversal system with multiple movement-based abilities and simple combat system.
Created a 2D platformer level featuring alternative pathways and enemy spawners.
